title: Curtain Wall Seismic Joint Displacement Clearance

input.extracted_text:
TECHNICAL REQUEST FOR INFORMATION
RFI Number: RFI-2026-003
Subject: Curtain Wall Seismic Joint Displacement Clearance at Tower Expansion Joint
Contract Reference: CON-2026-FAC-005
Raised Date: 2026-03-05
Due Date: 2026-03-12
Status: answered

QUESTION:
Architectural detail 4/A-501 specifies a 50mm expansion joint between the Podium and Main Tower. However, Structural General Notes S-001 indicate maximum inter-story drift under Seismic Design Category D of 75mm. Please confirm whether the facade expansion joint width must be enlarged to 85mm to prevent glass shattering.

RESPONSE:
Response Date: 2026-03-09
Approved: Increase expansion joint width to 90mm at all tower interface lines. Contractor to submit revised silicone bellows extrusion profile.
